name: Lucien
source:
AGE: XX | Ex-Reaper

A gentle boy, who tries his best to be intimidating, but always fails. His circumstances force him to keep his guard up, but he wants nothing more than to have a friend by his side.

His brother is the world to him and he will do anything to keep him safe, despite his own desires.

LIKES
Sandwiches. Tasty snacks. A warm bed. Fluffy pillows. Board games. Good books. Quiet.

DISLIKES
Rainy days. Loud noises. Busy streets. Long stares. Being alone. Fighting.
